description:
We are Astryva, a team of university students passionate about physics, space technology, and innovation. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to develop a web platform that harmonizes MODIS and VIIRS satellite hot spot data. Through interactive maps and visualizations, we hope to improve understanding of historical fire activity and its patterns. We value teamwork, creativity, and scientific accuracy.

Astryva — Beyond Data, Beyond Limits.
summary: FireLens Arabia is an interactive web platform developed by Team ASTRYVA to explore historical fire activity in Saudi Arabia using NASA satellite data. The project focuses on harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS hotspot records, making fire patterns easier to compare across time. Through interactive maps and historical visualizations, it aims to support environmental monitoring, research, and better-informed fire management decisions.
details:
FireLens Arabia is an interactive web platform developed by Team ASTRYVA to harmonize NASA MODIS and VIIRS thermal hotspot observations across Saudi Arabia.

The platform combines satellite observations by geographic grid cell and UTC day to create a unified activity calendar, while preserving original sensor records.

Using real NASA FIRMS data from 2024, we processed 42,384 observations into 19,997 unified active cell-days.

The platform includes an interactive 3D map, Fire Memory, Fire DNA, Fire Passport, and tools for exploring recurring thermal activity and seasonal patterns.

Our solution helps researchers and environmental agencies understand historical activity, identify areas requiring further investigation, and support evidence-based environmental monitoring.

Future development will include additional years, improved cross-sensor harmonization, and expanded geographic coverage.
